In a Thousand Years Even You Might be Worth Something is a quest achievement earned for completing the Harrison Jones quest chain in Uldum up to Harrison Jones and the Temple of Uldum. The entire quest-line revolves around the Coffer of Promise. The title is in reference to Indiana Jones. In the first film, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Indy's archrival René Belloq says this to him after trying to seal him away in the Well of Souls, after Indy found the Ark of the Covenant. Though the name of the quest required for this achievement is a reference to the second film, Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom, the quest chain as a whole is based largely on the first film.

]] In the Shadow of the Sun is a short story by Sarah Pine featured on the official site. It is the eleventh in the Leaders of Azeroth series and centers on the blood elves' regent lord Lor'themar Theron. The story was originally a piece of fan fiction that won the grand prize in Blizzard's 2008 Global Creative Writing Contest. A slightly edited version was later released as official lore on January 18, 2012.

The Infinite Stone increases the maximum amount of Ancient Mana a player can carry by 100.
Infernal Technicians are wyrmtongues found in the Assault on Broken Shore scenario.
Inert Ashes is a reward from the Class Hall mission Archmage Vargoth's Travels: Best Friends Forever.
Inferno Punch is Pick Pocketed from demons on the Broken Isles.
Infernal Furnace is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Doom, Doubled and Maw of Shadows traits.
Infernal Fatebringers are infernals summoned by Zorathides at the Obsidian Dragonshrine in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Infiltrator Assassins are orcs located in Assault on Violet Hold.
Infernal Flaskataur, Esq. is a tauren that appears on the PTR. He is located in Dalaran.
The Infinite Hatchling can be purchased from on the Timeless Isle at a cost of during Mists of Pandaria Timewalking.
Infernal Doombringers are infernals located at the Black Gate in as a part of the Archimonde encounter.
Inexorable Truth Serum drops from the Demonic Inquisition in the Tomb of Sargeras.

Infernal Causeway is a causeway leading down from the north of Deliverance Point to Impsorrow Approach in Broken Shore. Xorothian Fel Knights patrol the area. Occasionally, Prowling Shadowstalkers attack tauren to use them as bait, and patrols become trapped due to the scores of Stampeding Felsteeds blocking safe passage. Adventurers bring them Barrels of Storm Brew to reinvigorate the troops.
Infectious Gutworms are caterpillars located at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound.
Inert Stones drop primarily from elementals in Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
Infected Mossflayers are undead forest trolls found throughout Zul'Mashar in Eastern Plaguelands.
Infected Peasants are humans located in Waycrest Manor. Upon death, Devouring Maggots will burst from their corpse.
__NOTOC__ Infinite Drakelings are infinite drakes located in the Nighthold. They are Infinite Whelplings turned traitor.
Infectious Grubs are larvae summoned by Zemorath in Morheim in Stormheim during Legion Assaults.
Inert Hearthstones are looted from Alliance Bounties, Horde Bounties, and War Supply Chests.
Inert Leystone Charm is a common Highborne archaeology artifact, created from 45 Highborne Archaeology Fragments. One Ancient Suramar Scroll may be used to solve this artifact.

Infested Saurolisks are dead saurolisks located around the Four Stingers and on the ridges around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. Their bodies are covered in Bilewing Eggs (at the Four Stingers) or Whistlebloom Eggs (at Whistlebloom Oasis).
Infant Dino Kibble is bought from Meatminder Teki in Warbeast Kraal in Zuldazar for .
Infected Mechanics are goblins located in the Lost Veil Anzu in the Spires of Arak.
Infected Plunderers are goblins located in the Lost Veil Anzu in the Spires of Arak.
Inert Conquerors are terracotta warriors located in Warport Rastari in Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Inert Tide Watchers are harvest golems located in Drustvar, Stormsong Valley, and Tiragarde Sound.
The Inferno's March Shoulderpads is a quest reward from Trial of Valor: The Once and Future Lord of Shadows.
Infected Saurolisk Eggs are eggs located in the Primal Wetlands in Nazmir.
__NOTOC__ Infected Saurolisks are saurolisks located in the Primal Wetlands in Nazmir.
The Infernal Bloodstone Shard drops from Eredar Shadow Menders, has a small chance to drop from the elite mobs on the Broken Isles, and is contained in Relinquished Trinket.
Infected Direhorn is a direhorn located in Antul'Mita Plateau in Nazmir. He is being sucked on by blood ticks.
The Infernal Device is a demon portal found in Llothien Highlands in Azsuna. On orders of Brann Bronzebeard, it was reactivated by finding its parts, and it summoned Wyrmy Tunkins.
Infected Gazelles are gazelles located in Mulgore in the Emerald Nightmare.

Induction Samophlange is needed for the following quests: *Smoot's Samophlange, given by Fleep at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara *Of Utmost Importance, given by Patch aboard the Skyshredder in the Twilight Highlands
Inert Voodoo Masks are enchanted tikis located in Zuldazar, Nazmir, and Vol'dun.
Infesting Mindeaters are merciless ones located in Tiragarde Sound.
Inert Mineral Dust is left behind when infusing the following items into the Heart Forge: *Volatile Worldvein *Stalwart Worldvein *Fluctuating Worldvein *Brilliant Worldvein
__NOTOC__ Infested Vinewardens are infested located in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Infested Grunts are infested located in Teller Farm in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
The Inert Dragonscale is left behind when infusing the Charged Scale of the Blue Aspect into the Heart Forge.
Infected Rats are rats located in the basement of Timberfell Outpost in Tiragarde Sound.

Inert Slivers are left behind when infusing the Unbound Azerite Slivershards, Sharpened Azerite Slivershards, Polarized Azerite Slivershards, or Incandescent Azerite Slivershards into the Heart Forge.
Infesting Brainworms are caterpillars located in Tiragarde Sound.
Infested Wastewander Captain is a plague eruptor located in Uldum.
Infinite Pesterwings are infinite whelps that could be found in the Caverns of Time.
Infinite Vanguard is an infinite drakonid seen outside the Caverns of Time during the Warlords of Draenor beta.
